## Design

### 2026-10-07 — Today I worked on my Smart Disaster Safety System project. I planned how the sensors, microcontroller, buzzer, warning lights, and display will work together. I researched how gas and vibration sensor

**4h**

Today I worked on my Smart Disaster Safety System project. I planned how the sensors, microcontroller, buzzer, warning lights, and display will work together. I researched how gas and vibration sensors can detect dangerous situations and how the system can give an early warning. I also worked on the circuit design and thought about how I can improve the project in the future. I learned more about connecting sensors to a microcontroller and using programming to trigger alerts when a sensor reading passes a certain level.
